svg.title: Converge — database per service (H2 in-memory, one schema each)

g.text: Converge — database per service (H2 in-memory, one schema each)
owns no database. On main it is a skeleton;
from M3 its state lives in Kafka Streams state stores, rebuilt by
replaying topics and served by interactive queries.
owns no database and holds no state between
requests: each agenda request builds a throw-away AgendaTools
filled dot = NOT NULL · «PK» primary key · «FK» foreign key · «UNIQUE» unique constraint
||--o{ one-to-many foreign key inside a schema (aggregate root → its entities)
}o..|| reference by id inside a schema, no constraint
purple dotted value copied between schemas by a Kafka event; no cross-database join exists
processed_events: one row per consumed event id; a consumer skips an id it has
already recorded, which makes at-least-once delivery safe.
@Version optimistic locking exists only on session_views.version.
